comment: The node world a fresh server starts with (Nodes 1). citynode applies this file ONCE, at its first start (city_node_seed.applied_at). Edits later need: nodectl seed --force (it overwrites every node's level and parent, and says so). A node left out is Wilderness (level 0) with no parent. Levels: 0 Wilderness, 1 Crossroads, 2 Encampment, 3 Village, 4 Town (the most the data allows). A node is named by its record name (Verra_RVR_Joeva), the same without Verra_ (RVR_Joeva), or its display name (Joeva). A parent is a vassal's lord: Halcyon is Joeva's vassal, as in retail.
